sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot
items.blurb: A rewrite this size wasn't affordable before agents. Here's what porting the Copilot agent runtime to 800,000 lines of production Rust actually took.

items.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM with math (and Rust)
items.blurb: Cloudflare's global network is immense but not limitless. As we look for small ways to trim our resource usage, we sometimes get lucky and we can cut significantly more.

items.title: Leave the Class Path in the Rearview Mirror
items.blurb: We've been working for some time on closing the tooling gaps to allow working with the Java Module System seamless and make agents work better with the Java language.

items.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility
items.blurb: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors.

items.title: A Tale of Two Flink Autoscalers
When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts
items.blurb: A modern storefront can look healthy while malicious JavaScript quietly siphons revenue, hijacks clicks, or rewrites analytics. See how Cloudflare's machine learning models surface evasive client-side attacks for analyst investigation.

items.title: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training
items.blurb: Cloudflare is giving site owners a way to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training. New controls and an Accountable designation establish a shared model with Apple, Google, and Microsoft.
